case_accounting: These portability checks reproduce already-bounded complete-history comparator relationships and selected refusal states through a second standard-library implementation path. They are supplemental implementation-portability evidence and do not introduce a new Trust Fabric protocol success state, so the authored protocol matrix remains 130 cases.
selected_refusals: signed checkpoint/link mutation fails signature verification
omitted intermediate history fails closed as lineage-gap evidence
wrong explicitly expected predecessor fails closed
dependency_boundary: The Go verifier is standard-library only and does not import, execute, shell out to, or mechanically wrap the JavaScript comparator/reference runtime.
truth_boundary: Agreement proves only same-repository portability for one fixed set of supplied signed rotation-revocation checkpoint histories plus selected refusal states. It does not prove third-party interoperability, separately authored external independence, broad protocol conformance, discovery of unseen checkpoints or revocations, synchronization, globally newest/current state, fork resolution or winner selection, identity continuity, authority transfer, recovery, hostile-environment security, or AXM-wide CANON status.
unresolved: broad comparator conformance beyond the fixed vector
discovery or synchronization of unseen histories
canon_boundary: Repository merge does not promote this mechanism to AXM-wide CANON.
